charts.title: TOI-1846 b: orbits around TOI-1846
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-1846's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-1846 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Soubkiou et al. 2025 (2025MNRAS.541.3249S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname SOUBKIOU_ET_AL_2025): P 3.9306737 d

charts.title: TOI-1846 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-1846 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (84, 85, 86) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 198385543, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 4 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 5 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 6-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 4 min early; 6-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 2 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
